body: I long to accomplish a great and noble task; but it is my chief duty to accomplish small tasks as if they were great and noble
author: Helen Keller

body: I do not want the peace which passeth understanding, I want the understanding which bringeth peace.
author: Helen Keller

body: True happiness...is not attained through self-gratification, but through fidelity to a worthy purpose.
author: Helen Keller

body: Self-pity is our worst enemy and if we yield to it, we can never do anything wise in this world.
author: Helen Keller

body: We could never learn to be brave and patient, if there were only joy in the world
author: Helen Keller

body: When you know what you want, and want it bad enough, you will find a way to get it.
author: Jim Rohn

body: You cannot change your destination overnight, but you can change your direction overnight
author: Jim Rohn

body: You don't get paid for the hour. You get paid for the value you bring to the hour.
author: Jim Rohn

body: Success is doing ordinary things extraordinarily well.
author: Jim Rohn

body: Let others lead small lives, but not you. Let others argue over small things, but not you. Let others cry over small hurts, but not you. Let others leave their future in someone else's hands, but not you.
author: Jim Rohn

body: If you go to work on your goals, your goals will go to work on you. If you go to work on your plan, your plan will go to work on you. Whatever good things we build end up building us.
author: Jim Rohn

body: To solve any problem, here are three questions to ask yourself: First, what could I do? Second, what could I read? And third, who could I ask?
author: Jim Rohn

body: If you don't design your own life plan, chances are you'll fall into someone else's plan. And guess what they have planned for you? Not much.
author: Jim Rohn

body: Without a sense of urgency, desire loses its value.
author: Jim Rohn

body: Discipline is the bridge between goals and accomplishment.
author: Jim Rohn

body: Don't wish it were easier, wish you were better.
author: Jim Rohn

body: A good objective of leadership is to help those who are doing poorly to do well and to help those who are doing well to do even better.
author: Jim Rohn

body: If you are not willing to risk the unusual, you will have to settle for the ordinary.
author: Jim Rohn

body: Don't just read the easy stuff. You may be entertained by it, but you will never grow from it.
author: Jim Rohn

body: Either you run the day or the day runs you.
author: Jim Rohn

body: Success is not to be pursued; it is to be attracted by the person you become
author: Jim Rohn

body: Effective communication is 20% what you know and 80% how you feel about what you know.
author: Jim Rohn

body: How long should you try? Until.
author: Jim Rohn

body: Work harder on yourself than you do on your job.
author: Jim Rohn

body: Success is steady progress toward one's personal goals
author: Jim Rohn

body: Motivation is what gets you started. Habit is what keeps you going.
author: Jim Rohn

body: Character isn't something you were born with and can't change, like your fingerprints. It's something you weren't born with and must take responsibility for forming.
author: Jim Rohn

body: Take care of your body. It's the only place you have to live.
author: Jim Rohn

body: Happiness is not something you postpone for the future; it is something you design for the present.
author: Jim Rohn

body: There are only 3 colors, 10 digits, and 7 notes; its what we do with them that's important.
author: Jim Rohn

body: Get around people who have something of value to share with you. Their impact will continue to have a significant effect on your life long they have departed.
author: Jim Rohn

body: It is the set of the sails, not the direction of the wind that determines which way we will go.
author: Jim Rohn

body: The major reason for setting a goal is for what it makes of you to accomplish it. What it makes of you will always be the far greater value than what you get.
author: Jim Rohn

body: You must take personal responsibility. You cannot change the circumstances, the seasons, or the wind, but you can change yourself. That is something you have charge of.
author: Jim Rohn

body: Failure is not a single, cataclysmic event. You don't fail overnight. Instead, failure is a few errors in judgement, repeated every day.
author: Jim Rohn

body: Success is neither magical nor mysterious. Success is the natural consequence of consistently applying the basic fundamentals.
author: Jim Rohn

body: Be more concerned with your character than your reputation, because your character is what you really are, while your reputation is merely what others think you are.
author: John Wooden

body: Don't mistake activity with achievement.
author: John Wooden

body: The people who turn out best are those people who make the best out of the way things turn out.
author: John Wooden

body: It is amazing how much can be accomplished if no one cares who gets the credit.
author: John Wooden

body: You can't live a perfect day until you do something for someone who will never be able to repay you.
author: John Wooden

body: Ability may get you to the top, but it takes character to keep you there.
author: John Wooden

body: Never make excuses. Your friends don't need them and your foes won't believe them.
author: John Wooden

body: Listen if you want to be heard
author: John Wooden

body: Players with fight never lose a game, they just run out of time
author: John Wooden

body: If you don't have time to do it right, when will you have the time to do it over?
author: John Wooden

body: The true test of a man's character is what he does when no one is watching.
author: John Wooden

body: The best thing a father can do for his children is to love their mother.
author: John Wooden

body: It's the little details that are vital. Little things make big things happen.
author: John Wooden

body: Failing to prepare is preparing to fail.
author: John Wooden
